extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) A rectangle has 4 sides — opposite sides equal. (2) A square has 4 equal sides. (3) A triangle has 3 sides. (4) A circle is round — no sides, no corners. (5) A square IS a special rectangle. (6) 2D shapes are flat (circle, square, triangle, rectangle). Misconceptions: "square and rectangle are completely different" (a square IS a special rectangle), "circle is the same as a ball" (a ball is 3D, a circle is flat), "triangle is anything pointed" (a triangle has exactly 3 sides and 3 corners). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ShapeSortGame), NOT export default. Export interface ShapeSortGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
